reports.title: IonQ Announces Record 3Q26 Revenues and Raises FY2026 Guidance to $505 - $515 Million as Backlog Grows to $1.2 Billion

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: For the full year 2026, IonQ is raising its revenue guidance to between $505 million and $515 million. For the full year, IonQ expects strong growth of 110% year-on-year in its quantum computing revenue
